retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring intense red directional lighting that obscures half the face in deep shadow with a heavy film grain texture.
excludeWhen: bright or high-key lighting is required
clean digital look without noise is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a male subject where the left side of the face (viewer's left) is saturated in a deep, monochromatic red light, while the right side is cast in total black shadow. The image is characterized by a heavy, uniform digital noise or film grain and a flat, dark grey background.
coreVisualRelationships: Light vs. Shadow: A hard vertical divide splitting the face
Color vs. Neutrality: Vibrant red skin tones against a desaturated dark background
Texture vs. Form: Heavy grain softening the sharp anatomical features
Subject vs. Space: Tight framing emphasizing psychological intimacy
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from the illuminated eye

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders centered vertically; face occupies approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated eye on the left side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright red eye, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then dissipates into the dark shadow on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial dark space surrounding the head, particularly on the right side where the subject merges with the background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Red (Key light and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red channel; very low value (darkness) across the entire image.
paletteRestrictions: No white highlights; brightest points must be red

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man with a neutral expression. Apply a single strong red light source from the side to create a split-lighting effect. Ensure half the face is in total darkness. Add a heavy film grain texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif font in a muted grey or thin white, placed in the negative space of the dark side to maintain the moody balance.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting strictly red on one side?
Is the shadow side deep black without visible detail?
Is there a consistent grain/noise across the image?
Is the background dark and non-distracting?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the split lighting (more or less shadow)
mustRedesign: Avoid any secondary light sources or rim lights
Do not use natural skin tones; the light must be monochromatic red

avoid: Soft, diffused lighting that fills shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'crushed' blacks in the shadow side
Verify the red light does not bleed into a pink or orange hue
Ensure the grain does not obscure the primary eye
Confirm the background is a flat, dark neutral tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key studio portrait + [Subject] + hard red split lighting + deep chiaroscuro + heavy film grain + dark charcoal background.
